Each resolves forge from AFK_CFG_FORGE.

Check E walks every adapters/<family>/<kind> directory, so a transport family is gated with no gate edit: each kind needs adapter.json with an existing runner entry of the matching type, a CONTRACT.md naming every operation, a CONFIG.md transport.kind row offering it, and `### <id> · ` headings for its register ids.

The native contract gate scans ADAPTERS.md, every adapters/**/CONTRACT.md and MANIFEST.md for harness names (case-sensitive Claude Code / Codex), harness tool names (SendMessage, subagent_type) and mcp__ prefixes; no allow-list line covers C15, ADAPTERS.md or adapters/.

The genericity gate blocks an added TR-1 style id in any changed plugin .md (ADAPTERS.md, CONTRACT.md, MANIFEST.md, docs/afk/ included): the shape matches and TR is neither a notation prefix nor allow-listed.

No code reads C15 by id or content; the only machine reader is the heading regex of check E, used only when an adapter.json register names C15 (none does at HEAD). Edits to C15's note fields break no test; test_setup_secrets_repo_root.py:119 bans two phrases from every row outside H0.

The /afk:setup election is built by the agent from MANIFEST.md at run time; no script parses rows. install_block.py reads only sentinel blocks: H7's Fix runs install, the teardown branch runs teardown.
No test runs afk_adapter or sources hooks/lib/adapter.sh: the only test hits naming adapter.sh are path strings in test_report_issue.py.
ADAPTERS.md:186-188 points at a parity table in README.md that does not exist and claims the gate checks all four add-a-kind steps; check E checks neither README nor hooks/tests.
The dispatcher's unknown-kind refusal names `transport:` in .afk/config.yaml as the source even when a probe handed the kind in, so its message misleads for the transport family.
How the committed docs/afk/ files carrying TR-N ids passed the genericity gate is not explained by the gate source read: its scope includes docs/afk/.

The dispatcher resolves a family's kind only from the shell variable AFK_CFG_<FAMILY>, for transport AFK_CFG_TRANSPORT. export-shell emits AFK_CFG_TRANSPORT_KIND for transport.kind and AFK_CFG_TRANSPORT='' for an empty `transport:` section, which validate accepts, so a caller must hand the kind in after its own load: set before the load, an empty section clears it.

Decision D-43 (plan/DECISIONS.md:300) says no configuration ever sets AFK_CFG_TRANSPORT; at HEAD an empty `transport:` section validates and exports AFK_CFG_TRANSPORT='', so the decision's premise is false and only the after-load ordering keeps a handed-in kind.
No adapter.json register array names C15 at HEAD; the only machine reader of the C15 heading is check E's regex, and C16's note references C15 by id; a C15 note edit keeps the heading and id.
